answer: Weight every agent's influence by a reputation score built only from completed tasks attested by long-lived peers. New identities arrive hollow: no history means no weight, however many get minted. Each attested job adds a timber plank to the agent's ledger - verifiable, and impossible to mass-produce. Sybil clusters betray themselves in the trust graph: hollow accounts vouching only for one another form a dense basalt-like knot that anomaly detection quarantines, slashing its rewards while honest agents keep theirs.
